shloka_text: ऋषेर्वचनमाज्ञाय रामः सन्ध्यामुपासितुम् । उपाक्रमत्सरः पुण्यमप्सरोगणसेवितम् ।। 7.82.1 ।।
transliteration: ṛṣervacanamājñāya rāmaḥ sandhyāmupāsitum | upākramatsaraḥ puṇyamapsarogaṇasevitam || 7.82.1 ||
translation: ऋषेः of the sage, वचनम् word, आज्ञाय having understood, रामः Rama, सन्ध्याम् twilight prayer, उपासितुम् to perform, उपाक्रमत् approached, सरः lake, पुण्यम् sacred, अप्सरोगणसेवितम् frequented by groups of Apsaras
explanation: Having understood the sage's words, Rama approached a sacred lake, frequented by groups of Apsaras, to perform his twilight prayers.
comments: After evening prayers and a night at the hermitage, Rama takes leave; Agastya extols him as the purifier of all beings and the support of the world and bids him rule righteously -- mounting the Pushpaka, Rama reaches Ayodhya by midday, dismisses the chariot, and bids the doorkeeper summon Lakshmana and Bharata.

shloka_text: तत्रोदकमुपस्पृश्य सन्ध्यामन्वास्य पश्चिमाम् । आश्रमं प्राविशद्रामः कुम्भयोनेर्महात्मनः ।। 7.82.2 ।।
transliteration: tatrodakamupaspṛśya sandhyāmanvāsya paścimām | āśramaṃ prāviśadrāmaḥ kumbhayonermahātmanaḥ || 7.82.2 ||
translation: तत्र there, उदकम् water, उपस्पृश्य having performed ablutions, सन्ध्याम् twilight prayer, अन्वास्य having performed, पश्चिमाम् western (evening), आश्रमम् hermitage, प्राविशत् entered, रामः Rama, कुम्भयोनेः of Agastya, महात्मनः of the great-souled one
explanation: There, having performed ablutions and completed the evening twilight prayers, Rama entered the hermitage of the great-souled Agastya.

shloka_text: तस्यागस्त्यो बहुगुणं कन्दमूलं तथौषधिम् । शाल्यादीनि पवित्राणि भोजनार्थमकल्पयत् ।। 7.82.3 ।।
transliteration: tasyāgastyo bahuguṇaṃ kandamūlaṃ tathauṣadhim | śālyādīni pavitrāṇi bhojanārthamakalpayat || 7.82.3 ||
translation: तस्य for him, अगस्त्यः Agastya, बहुगुणम् of many qualities, कन्दमूलम् roots and fruits, तथा and, औषधिम् herbs, शाल्यादीनि rice and other grains, पवित्राणि pure, भोजनार्थम् for a meal, अकल्पयत् arranged
explanation: For Rama, Agastya arranged a meal consisting of excellent roots, fruits, herbs, and pure rice and other grains.

shloka_text: स भुक्तवान्नरश्रेष्ठस्तदन्नममृतोपमम् । प्रीतश्च परितुष्टश्च तां रात्रिं समुपाविशत् ।। 7.82.4 ।।
transliteration: sa bhuktavānnaraśreṣṭhastadannamamṛtopamam | prītaśca parituṣṭaśca tāṃ rātriṃ samupāviśat || 7.82.4 ||
translation: सः he, भुक्तवान् ate, नरश्रेष्ठः best among men, तत् that, अन्नम् food, अमृतोपमम् like nectar, प्रीतः pleased, च and, परितुष्टः fully satisfied, च and, ताम् that, रात्रिम् night, समुपाविशत् rested
explanation: The best among men, Rama, ate that nectar-like food, and being pleased and fully satisfied, he rested for that night.

shloka_text: प्रभाते काल्यमुत्थाय कृत्वा ऽ ऽह्निकमरिन्दमः । ऋषिं समुपचक्राम गमनाय रघूत्तमः ।। 7.82.5 ।।
transliteration: prabhāte kālyamutthāya kṛtvā ' 'hnikamarindamaḥ | ṛṣiṃ samupacakrāma gamanāya raghūttamaḥ || 7.82.5 ||
translation: प्रभाते in the morning, काल्यम् early morning duties, उत्थाय having risen, कृत्वा having performed, आह्निकम् daily rituals, अरिन्दमः subduer of enemies, ऋषिम् to the sage, समुपचक्राम approached, गमनाय for departure, रघूत्तमः best of the Raghu dynasty
explanation: In the morning, having risen and performed his daily rituals, Rama, the subduer of enemies and best of the Raghu dynasty, approached the sage for his departure.

shloka_text: अभिवाद्याब्रवीद्रामो महर्षिं कुम्भसम्भवम् । आपृच्छे स्वां पुरीं गन्तुं मामनुज्ञातुमर्हसि ।। 7.82.6 ।।
transliteration: abhivādyābravīdrāmo maharṣiṃ kumbhasambhavam | āpṛcche svāṃ purīṃ gantuṃ māmanujñātumarhasi || 7.82.6 ||
translation: अभिवाद्य having saluted, अब्रवीत् spoke, रामः Rama, महर्षिम् to the great sage, कुम्भसम्भवम् Agastya (born from a pot), आपृच्छे I ask leave, स्वां my own, पुरीं city, गन्तुम् to go, माम् me, अनुज्ञातुम् to permit, अर्हसि you ought.
explanation: Having saluted the great sage Agastya, Rama spoke, saying, "I ask your leave to go to my own city, and you ought to permit me."

shloka_text: धन्यो ऽस्म्यनुगृहीतो ऽस्मि दर्शनेन महात्मनः । द्रष्टुं चैवागमिष्यामि पावनार्थमिहात्मनः ।। 7.82.7 ।।
transliteration: dhanyo 'smyanugṛhīto 'smi darśanena mahātmanaḥ | draṣṭuṃ caivāgamiṣyāmi pāvanārthamihātmanaḥ || 7.82.7 ||
translation: धन्यः blessed, अस्मि I am, अनुगृहीतः favored, अस्मि I am, दर्शनेन by the sight, महात्मनः of the great soul, द्रष्टुं to see, च and, एव indeed, आगमिष्यामि I shall come, पावनार्थम् for the purification, इह here, आत्मनः of my self.
explanation: I am blessed and favored by the sight of your great self, and I shall indeed come here again to see you for the purification of my own soul.

shloka_text: तथा वदति काकुत्स्थे वाक्यमद्भुतदर्शनम् । उवाच परमप्रीतो धर्मनेत्रस्तपोधनः ।। 7.82.8 ।।
transliteration: tathā vadati kākutsthe vākyamadbhutadarśanam | uvāca paramaprīto dharmanetrastapodhanaḥ || 7.82.8 ||
translation: तथा thus, वदति when speaking, काकुत्स्थे by Rama, वाक्यम् words, अद्भुतदर्शनम् of wonderful meaning, उवाच spoke, परमप्रीतः extremely pleased, धर्मनेत्रः whose eye is dharma, तपोधनः whose wealth is austerity.
explanation: As Rama, whose words were of wonderful meaning, spoke thus, the sage Agastya, whose vision was righteousness and whose wealth was austerity, spoke, being extremely pleased.

shloka_text: अत्यद्भुतमिदं वाक्यं तव राम शुभाक्षरम् । पावनः सर्वभूतानां त्वमेव रघुनन्दन ।। 7.82.9 ।।
transliteration: atyadbhutamidaṃ vākyaṃ tava rāma śubhākṣaram | pāvanaḥ sarvabhūtānāṃ tvameva raghunandana || 7.82.9 ||
translation: अत्यद्भुतम् very wonderful, इदं this, वाक्यं speech, तव your, राम O Rama, शुभाक्षरम् of auspicious words, पावनः purifier, सर्वभूतानां of all beings, त्वम् you, एव indeed, रघुनन्दन O delight of the Raghus.
explanation: O Rama, your words are indeed very wonderful and auspicious, for you alone, O delight of the Raghus, are the purifier of all beings.

shloka_text: मुहूर्तमपि राम त्वां ये च पश्यन्ति केचन । पाविताः स्वर्गभूताश्च पूज्यास्ते सर्वदैवतैः ।। 7.82.10 ।।
transliteration: muhūrtamapi rāma tvāṃ ye ca paśyanti kecana | pāvitāḥ svargabhūtāśca pūjyāste sarvadaivataiḥ || 7.82.10 ||
translation: मुहूर्तम् for a moment, अपि even, राम O Rama, त्वाम् you, ये those who, च and, पश्यन्ति see, केचन some, पाविताः purified, स्वर्गभूताः become heavenly, च and, पूज्याः worshipable, ते they, सर्वदैवतैः by all deities.
explanation: O Rama, even those who merely see you for a moment become purified and attain heaven, and they are then worshipable by all deities.

shloka_text: ये च त्वां घोरचक्षुर्भिः पश्यन्ति प्राणिनो भुवि । हतास्ते यमदण्डेन सद्यो निरयगामिनः ।। 7.82.11 ।।
transliteration: ye ca tvāṃ ghoracakṣurbhiḥ paśyanti prāṇino bhuvi | hatāste yamadaṇḍena sadyo nirayagāminaḥ || 7.82.11 ||
translation: ये those who, च and, त्वां you, घोरचक्षुर्भिः with terrible eyes, पश्यन्ति see, प्राणिनो living beings, भुवि on earth, हतास्ते they are struck down, यमदण्डेन by Yama's rod, सद्यो immediately, निरयगामिनः going to hell
explanation: Those living beings on earth who look at you with hostile eyes are immediately struck down by the rod of Yama and go to hell.

shloka_text: ईदृशस्त्वं रघुश्रेष्ठ पावनः सर्वदेहिनाम् । भुवि त्वां कथयन्तो ऽपि सिद्धिमेष्यन्ति राघव ।। 7.82.12 ।।
transliteration: īdṛśastvaṃ raghuśreṣṭha pāvanaḥ sarvadehinām | bhuvi tvāṃ kathayanto 'pi siddhimeṣyanti rāghava || 7.82.12 ||
translation: ईदृशस्त्वं such are you, रघुश्रेष्ठ O best of Raghus, पावनः purifier, सर्वदेहिनाम् of all embodied beings, भुवि on earth, त्वां you, कथयन्तो speaking about, अपि even, सिद्धिमेष्यन्ति will attain perfection, राघव O scion of Raghu
explanation: O best of Raghus, you are such a purifier of all embodied beings, and even those on earth who merely speak of you, O scion of Raghu, will attain perfection.

shloka_text: गच्छ चारिष्टमव्याग्रः पन्थानमकुतोभयम् । प्रशाधि राज्यं धर्मेण गतिर्हि जगतो भवान् ।। 7.82.13 ।।
transliteration: gaccha cāriṣṭamavyāgraḥ panthānamakutobhayam | praśādhi rājyaṃ dharmeṇa gatirhi jagato bhavān || 7.82.13 ||
translation: गच्छ go, च and, अरिष्टम् auspicious, अव्याग्रः undisturbed, पन्थानम् path, अकुतोभयम् fearless, प्रशाधि rule, राज्यं kingdom, धर्मेण with righteousness, गतिर्हि indeed the support, जगतो of the world, भवान् you
explanation: Go forth calmly on an auspicious and fearless path, and rule your kingdom with righteousness, for you are indeed the support of the world.

shloka_text: एवमुक्तस्तु मुनिना प्राञ्जलिः प्रग्रहो नृपः । अभ्यवादयत प्राज्ञस्तमृषिं पुण्यशालिनम् ।। 7.82.14 ।।
transliteration: evamuktastu muninā prāñjaliḥ pragraho nṛpaḥ | abhyavādayata prājñastamṛṣiṃ puṇyaśālinam || 7.82.14 ||
translation: एवमुक्तस्तु thus spoken, मुनिना by the sage, प्राञ्जलिः with folded hands, प्रग्रहो humble, नृपः the king, अभ्यवादयत saluted, प्राज्ञः the wise (king), तम् that, ऋषिं sage, पुण्यशालिनम् endowed with merit
explanation: Thus addressed by the sage, the wise and humble king, with folded hands, saluted that virtuous sage.

shloka_text: अभिवाद्य मुनिश्रेष्ठं तांश्च सर्वांस्तपोधनान् । अध्यारोहत्तदव्यग्रः पुष्पकं हेमभूषितम् ।। 7.82.15 ।।
transliteration: abhivādya muniśreṣṭhaṃ tāṃśca sarvāṃstapodhanān | adhyārohattadavyagraḥ puṣpakaṃ hemabhūṣitam || 7.82.15 ||
translation: अभिवाद्य having saluted, मुनिश्रेष्ठं the best of sages, तांश्च and them, सर्वान् all, तपोधनान् ascetics, अध्यारोहत् ascended, तदव्यग्रः then undisturbed, पुष्पकं the Pushpaka (aerial chariot), हेमभूषितम् adorned with gold
explanation: Having saluted the best of sages and all those ascetics, he then calmly ascended the Pushpaka chariot, which was adorned with gold.

shloka_text: तं प्रयान्तं मुनिगणा ह्याशीर्वादैः समन्ततः । अपूजयन्महेन्द्राभं सहस्राक्षमिवामराः ।। 7.82.16 ।।
transliteration: taṃ prayāntaṃ munigaṇā hyāśīrvādaiḥ samantataḥ | apūjayanmahendrābhaṃ sahasrākṣamivāmarāḥ || 7.82.16 ||
translation: तं him, प्रयान्तं departing, मुनिगणाः groups of sages, हि indeed, आशीर्वादैः with blessings, समन्ततः from all sides, अपूजयन् worshipped, महेन्द्राभं resembling Mahendra, सहस्राक्षम् one with a thousand eyes, इव like, अमराः gods.
explanation: As Rama departed, groups of sages honored him from all sides with blessings, just as the gods worship Indra, who resembles Mahendra and has a thousand eyes.

shloka_text: स्वस्थः स ददृशे रामः पुष्पके हेमभूषिते । शशी मेघसमीपस्थो यथा जलधरागमे ।। 7.82.17 ।।
transliteration: svasthaḥ sa dadṛśe rāmaḥ puṣpake hemabhūṣite | śaśī meghasamīpastho yathā jaladharāgame || 7.82.17 ||
translation: स्वस्थः at ease, सः he, ददृशे was seen, रामः Rama, पुष्पके in the Pushpaka, हेमभूषिते adorned with gold, शशी the moon, मेघसमीपस्थो situated near a cloud, यथा just as, जलधरागमे at the arrival of rain clouds.
explanation: Rama, at ease in the gold-adorned Pushpaka, appeared like the moon near a cloud at the onset of the monsoon season.

shloka_text: ततो ऽर्धदिवसे प्राप्ते पूज्यमानस्ततस्ततः । अयोध्यां प्राप्य काकुत्स्थो मध्यकक्ष्यामवारुहत् ।। 7.82.18 ।।
transliteration: tato 'rdhadivase prāpte pūjyamānastatastataḥ | ayodhyāṃ prāpya kākutstho madhyakakṣyāmavāruhat || 7.82.18 ||
translation: ततः then, अर्धदिवसे midday, प्राप्ते having arrived, पूज्यमानः being honored, ततस्ततः from all sides, अयोध्यां to Ayodhya, प्राप्य having reached, काकुत्स्थो Rama, मध्यकक्ष्याम् the middle chamber, अवारुहत् descended.
explanation: Then, by midday, Rama, being honored from all sides, reached Ayodhya and descended into the middle chamber of his palace.

shloka_text: ततो विसृज्य रुचिरं पुष्पकं कामगामि तत् । विसर्जयित्वा गच्छेति स्वस्ति ते ऽस्त्विति च प्रभुः ।। 7.82.19 ।।
transliteration: tato visṛjya ruciraṃ puṣpakaṃ kāmagāmi tat | visarjayitvā gaccheti svasti te 'stviti ca prabhuḥ || 7.82.19 ||
translation: ततः then, विसृज्य having dismissed, रुचिरं beautiful, पुष्पकं Pushpaka, कामगामि moving at will, तत् that, विसर्जयित्वा having dismissed, गच्छ go, इति thus, स्वस्ति welfare, ते to you, अस्तु let it be, इति thus, च and, प्रभुः the lord.
explanation: Then, the lord Rama dismissed that beautiful Pushpaka, which moved at will, saying "Go, and let there be welfare for you."

shloka_text: कक्षान्तरविनिक्षिप्तं द्वास्स्थं रामो ऽब्रवीद्वचः । लक्ष्मणं भरतं चैव गत्वा तौ लघुविक्रमौ ।। ममागमनमाख्याय शब्दापयत मा चिरम् ।। 7.82.20 ।।
transliteration: kakṣāntaravinikṣiptaṃ dvāssthaṃ rāmo 'bravīdvacaḥ | lakṣmaṇaṃ bharataṃ caiva gatvā tau laghuvikramau || mamāgamanamākhyāya śabdāpayata mā ciram || 7.82.20 ||
translation: कक्षान्तरविनिक्षिप्तं placed in an inner chamber, द्वास्स्थं to the doorkeeper, रामो Rama, अब्रवीत् spoke, वचः words, लक्ष्मणं Lakshmana, भरतं Bharata, च and, एव indeed, गत्वा having gone, तौ those two, लघुविक्रमौ swift-footed, मम my, आगमनम् arrival, आख्याय having announced, शब्दापयत summon, मा not, चिरम् long.
explanation: Rama then spoke to the doorkeeper, who was stationed in an inner chamber, instructing him to swiftly go and inform Lakshmana and Bharata of his arrival, and to summon them without delay. इत्यार्षे श्रीमद्रामायणे वाल्मीकीये आदिकाव्ये श्रीमदुत्तरकाण्डे व्द्यशीतितमः सर्गः ।। 82 ।। Thus ends the eighty-second sarga of Uttara Kanda of the holy Ramayana the first epic composed by sage Valmiki.
